analogy.rationale: Glutamate receptors (GRIA/GRIK ionotropic, GRM metabotropic) are largely neuronal and are barely expressed in these non-neural cell lines, so agonists should elicit little transcriptional response; the closest reference classes are other glutamate-receptor-acting drugs, with GPCR/receptor classes that also act on poorly expressed receptors as weaker analogs.
